name: bandit.r033_registered_smoke_samelevel_dedup_mcw
description: R-033 isolated same-level smoke successor. It evaluates only a source-bound native smokebomb emission through the first two authoritative staffed-observer cadences: first creation, then unchanged identity/dedup. Fixture registration and activation are zero credit.

proof_gates.label: R-033 same-level smoke reaches one current source-bound live session

steps.label: operate_r033_registered_smoke_samelevel_dedup
steps.objective: Before input, bind the singleton idle site/member 18 and active same-level smoke source. At the first cadence retain the source-bound smoke scan, accepted observer callback, and created durable signal lead. Leave the source unchanged; at the second cadence retain the same lead identity and unchanged/dedup receipt with exact count/hash comparison.
proof_targets: singleton registered idle site and observer identity
same-level solid-floor source and expiry beyond two cadences
first source-bound smoke scan and accepted callback/created lead
second source-bound smoke scan and unchanged lead identity/dedup
sound/light absence and exact lead count/hash at both boundaries
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen bounded waits
invariants: registration and item activation are zero-credit
source remains unchanged between the two cadences
do not treat unrelated presentation as callback evidence

evidence_contract.claim: one source-bound R-033 run supplies only independently observed native smoke-to-created-lead and same-source dedup facts
evidence_contract.failure_rule: a conflating source, missing binding, missing singleton observer identity, missing first callback, or identity-changing second read leaves the affected claim unproved
